basis.governing_question: Which new point-of-sale system should Farmácias Lusas choose, and how can it roll the system out to its 40 pharmacies?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Define the business requirements and process fit-gaps across the 40 pharmacies that a new point-of-sale system must meet.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go or no-go on vendor selection against the agreed requirements?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Select the point-of-sale vendor by scoring shortlisted options against the requirements and plan the rollout across the pharmacies.

gate.label: Vendor selection
gate.decision: Which point-of-sale vendor and rollout plan go forward to Implementation?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the selected point-of-sale system to all 40 pharmacies with the client's operations and IT teams.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the rollout as complete in all 40 pharmacies?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; 21-27 weeks is an estimate resting on the archetype's phase lengths and a rollout across 40 pharmacies.
Archetype technology_selection_implementation ends at vendor selection; Implementation was added because the brief asks to roll the chosen system out to all 40 pharmacies.
No Change & Training phase: training and adoption can be planned inside Implementation; confirm whether the client wants them as a separate stage.
